# Pinned Hermes installer test fixture

`hermes-install.ps1` is the official `NousResearch/hermes-agent` installer from commit `bf0203a794a07aac3ff764972ab9087baa4e4f4e`, pinned at:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/bf0203a794a07aac3ff764972ab9087baa4e4f4e/scripts/install.ps1

`PIN.json` records its byte count, SHA-256, and Git blob ID. The test fixture supports offline integrity and mocked-download safety tests; tests do not execute this script.
